g.text: GALINI · L01 · bridge / passage coordinate sections
Complete support and enclosure intent / 1:1 horizontal and vertical scale / later AML must realize and verify it
BR-M + I04 · longitudinal bounds (eastward)
World bounds: span x 50–78, y 54–60, floor
+4. Deck 0.60 m thick; 5.30 m clear between
side parapets. Two masonry piers join the -6
m scenic bed; substantial rock-bank abutments
close both ends. Arch shaping is
architectural development, not a floating
thin slab.
Passage ceiling: z 7, clear 3.0 m above
floor. Nonplayable building continues upward
to its roof. O03 is transverse to this
section; the actual route turns south around
it before leaving.
Schematic construction section using declared coordinate bounds. Piers/abutments are scenic solids; no ravine access. See roof plan for full building height.
BR-U + I05 · longitudinal bounds (eastward)
World bounds: span x 50–76, y 86–92, floor
+8. Deck 0.70 m thick; 5.30 m clear between
side parapets. Two masonry piers join the -6
m scenic bed; substantial rock-bank abutments
close both ends. Arch shaping is
architectural development, not a floating
thin slab.
Passage ceiling: z 12, clear 4.0 m above
floor. Nonplayable building continues upward
to its roof. The upper arch remains straight
and supports an aligned follower view.
Schematic construction section using declared coordinate bounds. Piers/abutments are scenic solids; no ravine access. See roof plan for full building height.
